# Enterprise Ready Packs

> Free curated directory from Compile7 of vendors and open-source projects that B2B SaaS companies
> use to add the capabilities enterprise customers expect. Each entry is a one-line description and
> a link to the vendor. Free to browse, no sign-up.

Categories on the page:

- Product assortment (subscription billing and payments)
- Role-based access control (authorization services and policy engines)
- Team management and single sign-on (SSO, SAML, SCIM, identity platforms)
- Reporting and analytics
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
- Feature management (feature flags)
- SLA and support: application performance monitoring, external monitoring, customer success
- Product security: ASPM, DAST and SAST, plus other security solutions
- Integrations
- Documentation
- Contract life cycle management
- SDK library generators
- Compliance certification (compliance automation and GRC platforms)

## Links

- [Enterprise Ready Packs](https://enterpriseready.compile7.org/): the directory
- [Compile7](https://compile7.org/): the Compile7 family of free developer tools
- [Compile7 tools](https://compile7.org/tools/): all Compile7 tools
